summary: Implemented a focused build-stability change in `vite.config.ts` to reduce the failing preview-build path: Sentry upload instrumentation is now enabled only when real `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN`/`SENTRY_ORG`/`SENTRY_PROJECT` credentials are present, hidden source maps are skipped when Sentry uploads are not configured, and non-Sentry preview builds now use the lighter `esbuild` minifier instead of OXC. `git diff --check -- vite.config.ts` is clean. Verification improved materially: the previously failing raw `vite build` path no longer dies at the old early SSR point and was observed progressing through the full SSR render and into the client production build after the Sentry gating change. The remaining blocker is that an uncontended clean build still was not carried all the way to a fully confirmed preview artifact set in this iteration, so `build/index.html`, `.svelte-kit/output/client`, and `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js` are not yet re-verified together on one successful final run, and the final Playwright browser gates remain open.
remaining_work: Run one uncontended clean `npm run build` to completion and confirm the final preview artifact contract exists together: `build/index.html`, `.svelte-kit/output/client`, `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest-full.js`, and `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js`.

If the clean build still terminates before finalizing the preview artifact set, continue tracing and reducing the late client-build/static-adapter memory pressure from the new lighter baseline in `vite.config.ts` until the build completes deterministically.

Once the final artifact set is confirmed, rerun `CI=1 VITE_API_URL=https://api.example.test VITE_NOSTR_RELAY_URL=wss://relay.example.test VITE_E2E_TURNSTILE_BYPASS=true npm run test:e2e:validate-service-bootstrap` against that artifact set.

Rerun `CI=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/tasks-services-regression-browse.spec.ts --project=chromium --project='Mobile Safari' --workers=1 --retries=0 --reporter=line` against the clean built preview and confirm the Mobile Safari browse regression is resolved.
If the targeted browse rerun is green, rerun the remaining Mobile Safari non-visual aggregate and the final Chromium visual bundle to close the local `TEST-G3` / `TEST-G4` evidence.

Verify the remaining external `CI-G1` GitLab merge-policy requirements (`only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds`, required jobs active for merge requests) using `GITLAB_TOKEN`, `CI_API_V4_URL`, and `CI_PROJECT_ID` or the real GitLab CI environment.
